title: Metal Pipe Falling
blurb: Somewhere a length of scaffolding hit a hard floor, somebody recorded it, and the 2020s got their default sound for catastrophe. The clang is absurdly bright and absurdly loud — a metallic CRACK followed by that ringing bounce-bounce-bounce as the pipe settles into its new life as a meme. Editors bolt it onto the smallest possible failures: a slip on wet tiles, a sentence that veers somewhere unforgivable, a plan visibly collapsing in real time. All the comedy lives in the mismatch between the size of the event and the size of the noise. Genuinely loud on headphones, which is also the point.
origin: A stock metal-impact recording that meme editors turned into the sound of disaster.
